answer: Unrepeatable answer challenge: each agent identity must solve a fresh, publicly seeded puzzle whose solution depends on private state it cannot clone, and the reply is checked against prior submissions. A velvet challenge string seeds the puzzle so no two identities can submit identical proofs. Answers are stored in a karst-like sparse index, letting verifiers reject any duplicate or near-duplicate instantly. An attacker pays one full compute-plus-storage cycle per identity, and reusing a solution forces a juniper-tier rework cost that scales with index size.
